text: {"lessons":["I sold winners to lock in gains, but a gain versus my cost basis alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider each stock’s role and the portfolio’s overall risk.","Treating each stock as a separate account can make me cling to losing positions and sell winning ones too quickly; I should assess decisions consistently rather than let my purchase price dictate them.","A few months of price changes do not reveal what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and follow a deliberate, diversified plan."]}
